description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'PatientProgramValidatorTest' which tests the validation logic for the 'PatientProgramValidator' class within the OpenMRS system. The tests cover various validation scenarios for patient programs, including date validations, state overlap, duplicate states, and handling of edge cases like retired workflows.

classes.name: PatientProgramValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of PatientProgramValidator in different scenarios.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThePatientFieldIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the 'patient' field in PatientProgram is blank.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObjIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to validate() throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStateHasAnEndDateBeforeItsStartDate
methods.description: Tests validation when a PatientState has an end date before its start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsMoreThanOnePatientStateWithTheSameStatesAndStartDates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate states with same start dates in the same program.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStateHasANullWorkFlowState
methods.description: Validation fails when a PatientState's workflow state is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheProgramPropertyIsNull
methods.description: Test case ensuring validation fails if the program property is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStatesOverlapEachOtherInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Tests validation when PatientStates overlap in the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidProgram
methods.description: Validates a correctly formed PatientProgram.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientProgramHasDuplicateStatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Checks for duplicate states within the same workflow in the program.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientStateHasAnInvalidWorkFlowState
methods.description: Tests validation failure for invalid workflow states.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientIsInMultipleStatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if a patient is in multiple states simultaneously in the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAPatientIsInMultipleStatesInDifferentWorkFlows
methods.description: Validation passes if patient states are in different workflows.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheStartDateOfTheFirstPatientStateInTheWorkFlowIsNull
methods.description: Test that validation passes if the initial state's start date is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForPatientStatesThatHaveTheSameStartDatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Checks that same start dates within the same workflow do not cause validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsMoreThanOneStateWithANullStartDateInTheSameWorkflow
methods.description: Validation fails if multiple states have null start dates within the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfPatientStateIsInRetiredWorkflow
methods.description: Test that validation does not fail if the workflow is retired.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEndDateComesBeforeItsEnrolledDate
methods.description: Validation fails when the program end date is before the enrolled date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEnrolledDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the enrolled date is in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEndDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Validation fails if the end date is in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEnrollDateIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the enrolled date is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validation passes if string fields like voidReason have acceptable lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Validation fails if fields like voidReason exceed length limits.
